name: Notsin
source:
Notsin is an otome/visual novel video game where you play as a lost soul who awakens in Mictlán. To achieve transcendence, you must traverse the nine levels of Mictlán, each guarded by a powerful being.

Face the nine challenges and win the heart of each guardian.

[Translated from [url=https://sea-rabbit.itch.io/notsin]Itch.io[/url]]
